example.title: Ninabuck Road Bridge, Ninabuck Road over the Crawfish River
example.place: Danville vicinity, Town of Elba, Dodge County, WI

brief: Single-lane, eight-panel pin-connected Pratt through truss, 123.5 ft span (154.5 ft with approaches) and 16 ft deck, standing on four concrete-filled steel cylinder piers instead of masonry abutments. Top chords and inclined end posts are laced channels with cover plates, verticals laced double channels, diagonals paired eyebars; portal struts of latticed angles; open metal-grate deck on nine I-beam floor beams; a simple two-line rail on posts inside the trusses and black-and-white hazard boards at each portal. Sits low over a quiet rural river on a narrow blacktop town road flanked by grass and bare trees (truss height estimated).

names.plate: 1907 · KETTLE RIVER BRIDGE · CEDAR FORD TOWNSHIP · NORTHWEST IRON & BRIDGE WORKS, BUILDERS
